Numerical category-count facts derived from oscar6echo/Poker2
https://github.com/oscar6echo/Poker2
Pinned commit: f4c46143a6f4504f2b2fe82da88dadec84f1c46a
Source: Tables/df_preflop_hand_distrib.csv

The app contains only a new compact numerical aggregate: final best-five-category
counts over all C(50,5) = 2,118,760 boards for each of 169 starting classes.
The raw CSV SHA-256 is recorded in Resources/preflop-reference.json.
No upstream implementation, raw table or visualization is redistributed.
No license file was present in the pinned repository. This notice attributes the
numerical source and does not claim a license to redistribute its source code.
The importer and runtime code are independently written for this local app.

The separate heads-up matchup CSV was rejected after independent checks found
AA/KK discrepancies beyond five-million-deal sampling bounds. It is not bundled
or used for equity. The upstream Monte Carlo aggregate was also not integrated.
These category counts do not estimate win equity or actual opponents' ranges.
